description: This file manages the staging and linking of plugin runtime files, including creating symbolic links, copying specific files, and wrapping JavaScript modules for a plugin system. It handles directory traversal, symlink management, and runtime overlay setup for plugin extensions.

methods.name: symlinkType
methods.description: Determines the symlink type based on the operating system.

methods.name: relativeSymlinkTarget
methods.description: Calculates the relative path from target to source for symlink creation.

methods.name: ensureSymlink
methods.description: Creates or recreates a symlink at the target path pointing to the target value.

methods.name: symlinkPath
methods.description: Creates a symlink from source to target path.

methods.name: shouldWrapRuntimeJsFile
methods.description: Checks if a file has a .js extension to determine if it should be wrapped.

methods.name: shouldCopyRuntimeFile
methods.description: Checks if a file matches specific filenames to be copied directly.

methods.name: writeRuntimeModuleWrapper
methods.description: Generates a wrapper module that re-exports and imports the target module.

methods.name: stagePluginRuntimeOverlay
methods.description: Recursively overlays plugin runtime files from source to target directory, wrapping or copying files as needed.

methods.name: linkPluginNodeModules
methods.description: Creates a symlink for node_modules directory within a plugin.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntime
methods.description: Main exported function that sets up the runtime environment for plugin extensions, handling directory structure and linking.
